title: Me With My "Jo Tu Kahegi Wahi Hoga"
public_concept: A soft storybook carousel of everyday Indian couple scenes proving that his "jo tu kahegi" is not defeat; it is chosen participation in her tiny world.
human_truth: Some relationships are not built on who wins. They are built on one person making room for the other's tiny universe and liking it there.
emotional_obstacle: The line could sound like obedience or a perfect-boyfriend brag if treated literally. The carousel must make it feel like mutual private-language love.
aachu_role: Aachu brings spark, preference, drama, tiny rules, and the private world the artifacts orbit around.
zuv_role: Zuv is active: he adjusts the plan, softens timing, checks the proof, steps into her world, and turns theek hai into a love language.
emotional_arc: private phrase hook -> everyday plan-change proof -> playful escalation -> choice-not-defeat turn -> earned theek-hai payoff
hard_boundaries: Do not turn this into a generic green-flag boyfriend carousel.
Do not make the visuals photoreal, pasted-photo collage, quote-card realism, or prop-first paper surfaces.
Do not copy Scrawled Stories, JioHotstar, celebrity frames, logos, or exact reference layouts.
Every final visual must be a full Aachu/Zuv illustrated scene where body language proves the line.
